parts:
Dear all,

Tomorrow will be first meeting of the advanced group. It will start at
16h in B6 of the Biological Faculty.
The meeting will be divided in two parts.
First, professor Gogala will demonstrate the package Seewave in R. This
is a package which can be used for the analysis of acoustic data.
In the second part of the meeting there will be a discussion about the
setup of the meetings of the R beginners.

Hope to see you all!

kind regards,

Maarten and Tomaz
